name: htop
summary: Interactive host process viewer and system monitor
description: htop is a cross-platform interactive process viewer. Inside Clipak, it accesses the unconfined host /proc and PID namespaces to monitor every host process, container, and system service on atomic Linux distributions.

curation.unconfined_reason: Requires unconfined read/write access to host /proc, host PID namespaces, and POSIX process signaling
